_doc: Ledger Rivals (Lead-owned design; Agent 3 may extend names/traits/lines). DESIGN RULES that keep this system distinct from other studios' patented designs: (1) a SMALL authored cast per Era, not an army hierarchy; (2) no ranks / promotions / power-ups gained by defeating the player; (3) no rival-vs-rival vendettas; (4) rivals pursue FACTION OBJECTIVES (extraction plans) and are driven by the Consequence Ledger, not by personal revenge loops; (5) the player's moral/non-lethal options (negotiate, expose, release, bond) are first-class outcomes, not alternatives to a kill. Not legal advice: have an IP attorney review before launch.

survey_chief.label: Dominion Survey Chief
survey_chief.title: Survey Chief
intro: {title} {name}. This permit covers every rock you are standing on.
Handler. {title} {name}, Dominion survey. You are standing in my site.
Permit seven-one-four. Read it, then step back.
This bough is under survey. Walk around it, Handler.
Do you know how many people stand behind this permit? Neither do I. That is the point.

flee: Fall back to the camp. Call the drones.
This is above my pay grade. Permit stands. I do not.
defeated: Log it. Log all of it.
You will get a fine. I will get a promotion.
negotiate: Tell me what you need. I will tell you what I can lose.
A schedule. Fine. I will put it in writing.
expose: That file is not mine. That file is Dexter's. Ask him.
release: I will remember this. I am not sure how.

contract_poacher.label: Contract Poacher
contract_poacher.title: Poacher
intro: You are bad for business, Handler.
Criminal extraction? Please. I call it supply.
Everything in that cage has a buyer. You are costing me their names.
I am not a villain, Handler. I am a delivery with an invoice.
Walk on. You did not see me.

flee: Not worth it. Not worth it.
defeated: That is the last of my stock.
My buyers will not like this.
negotiate: Cut me in and I will point you at the real traffickers.
A fair price for the cage. I can live with that.
expose: Do not post my face. I have a family.
release: You are a soft one, Handler. I mean it kindly.
bond: A Bond Contract. Voluntary. In writing. I have never signed one.

free_scale_radical.label: Free Scale Radical
free_scale_radical.title: Cell Leader
intro: I will not be your good side, Handler.
Everyone who says they are protecting this place is selling it.
You carry a Dominion permit. That is a choice.
Free Scale does not need a Handler. Free Scale needs the door shut.
I will say this once: leave the rig.

flee: Pull back. We will be at the next one.
defeated: The cause is not a person.
You are saving a cage with a nicer lock.
negotiate: Put the extraction on hold and I stand down.
If Mara's name is on the file, I will read it.
expose: Fine. Expose me. Then expose your own.
bond: Bond. Not owned. Say it back.

helix_recovery_agent.label: Helix Recovery Agent
helix_recovery_agent.title: Recovery Agent
intro: Everything in this crate has a chain of custody. Yours is incomplete.
I am authorized to recover company property, Handler. That includes the rock.
This silk is Helix-licensed. The license is on file. Would you like to see the file?
I do not take things, Handler. I recover them.
Your name is on the incident report. Mine is on the solution.

flee: Recovery drones, withdraw to the sled.
I will file for the rest.
defeated: Chain of custody is broken. That is a very expensive sentence.
negotiate: Helix has a division for voluntary supply. I will make a call.
expose: That contract is not mine. I only deliver it.
release: I would like to say thank you. The form does not have a box for that.

meticulous.taunt: I have a contingency for the contingency.

debt_ridden.taunt: Every hour on this site is money I do not have.

proud.taunt: You do not walk away from me.

cautious.taunt: Distance is a kind of armor.

cruel.taunt: Which one of you is slower?

adapt_lines.shielded_advance: Heavy swings. I stay inside the arc.
adapt_lines.stay_off_the_line: I watched you throw that mace down a straight line. I am not standing on one.
adapt_lines.spread_formation: Do not bunch up. He pulls.
adapt_lines.kite_and_wait: Let him burn himself out. That rage is not free.
adapt_lines.break_the_pairing: Split them. They only work together.
adapt_lines.bait_projectiles: Her little spheres curve. I know where they curve.
adapt_lines.erratic_timing: She sees what I will do. So I do not decide until I move.
adapt_lines.ignore_echoes: The double shimmers wrong. I ignore it.
adapt_lines.stagger_guard: She can skip a heartbeat of mine. I keep two guards up.

scar_phrases.dented_pauldron: This pauldron is still dented from your mace.
scar_phrases.cracked_visor: My visor is cracked because of you.
scar_phrases.torn_sleeve: You tore my sleeve. That was a good sleeve.
scar_phrases.split_lip: You split my lip last time.
scar_phrases.trembling_hand: My hand still trembles when I think of that skip.
scar_phrases.tired_eyes: I have not slept since she watched me.

escaped: You let me walk. {scar_phrase} I used the time.
negotiated: We have terms, Handler. Do not make me regret them.
A deal is a deal. I am checking yours.
Our terms stand. I am watching yours.
Terms. I read them again this morning.
released: I have not forgotten that you could have finished it.
You let me go. I am still deciding what that means.
You could have ended it. I have been thinking about that for days.
exposed: Everything I was hiding is public. I am still standing here. Make of that what you will.
You made me honest. I did not ask.
defeated: You won. I am still here. {adapt_line}
bonded: Handler. I am keeping my word.
